hook.hook: Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

captions.instagram:
Nobody tells you November is still garlic planting time

I always plant my cloves in autumn so they get a good start before winter. If you want to know how to grow garlic in the UK, just pick a sunny spot with well drained soil. Keep the bed clear of weeds and you will have plenty to harvest by summer.

Do not store raw garlic in oil at room temperature, as there is a risk of botulism.

Check your local frost dates.

posts.search_phrase: what to do with a glut of lamb’s lettuce

hook.hook: Lamb’s lettuce glut? Don't let it rot

captions.instagram:
Lamb’s lettuce glut? Don't let it rot

I often get asked what to do with a glut of lamb’s lettuce when the patch produces more than we can eat at once. It is easy to grow for a balcony or small garden, but it only lasts three to five days in the fridge. I pick whole rosettes or outer leaves as needed, or wilt the extra leaves into soups to freeze.

Check your local frost dates.
